hook_lines: This KitKat is only sold at Don Quijote Japan

chalkboard.title: What People Are Saying
bullets: Confirmed "Don Quijote exclusive" by Nestlé's own official account
White chocolate + sakura leaf powder, with real kinako mixed into the wafer cream
Reviews split hard: "kinako hits the second you open it" vs "barely any kinako taste"
First launched around 2018, still returning to Don Quijote shelves as a seasonal item years later

usage_placeholder.description: 실제로 킷캣 사쿠라 키나코맛을 먹는 리액션 영상. 한 입 베어물고 콩가루 향과 벚꽃 화이트초콜릿 맛에 반응하는 표정 위주 클로즈업, 웨하스 단면(크림 켜켜이)을 보여주는 장면이 있으면 더 좋음. 10~15초 분량이면 충분.
usage_placeholder.xiaohongshu_query: 日本 KitKat 樱花黄豆粉 桜きなこ 试吃

quotes.japanese: 開けた瞬間からきなこの香りがふわりと香って期待大！！
quotes.translation: The moment I opened it, the kinako aroma wafted out — got me really excited!!

quotes.japanese: きなこがつよい 味はきなこにひっそり桜が混じってる感じです
quotes.translation: The kinako flavor is strong — it tastes like kinako with just a hint of sakura mixed in.

quotes.japanese: 小分けの袋を開けると濃厚で香ばしいきなこの香りがガッツリ
quotes.translation: Open one of the individually wrapped pieces and you get a thick, toasty kinako smell right away.

quotes.japanese: あまりきな粉感はないけれど桜風味とホワイトチョコレートも好きなので私はとても美味しかったです
quotes.translation: I didn't get much of a kinako taste, but I love the sakura flavor and white chocolate, so it was still really delicious to me.
